skillTree.localised_description: A Bellower’s voice is as deep as it loud, carrying across the battlefield and encouraging unbridled carnage.
A small handful of Gnoblars surround this Ogre Lord, their swords always ready to cut and carve.
Stumpy and short-witted as they are, these Gnoblars have an eye on the sky at all times.
It never hurts to keep your lucky Gnoblar with you, just in case.
Puny magicks are nothing in the face of the Great Maw's endless hunger.
In the eyes of the brave, danger gleams like sunshine.
The Gnoblars are often cowardly and confused, but when Katerina leads them, they cast aside their fears and fight.

skillTree.localised_description: "She was born to silk and song, but raised in blood and steel."
She bleeds for her tribe, and they fight for her. At her call, they rush together, man and beast alike.

skillTree.localised_description: She is no mere mortal. Her step is that of a hunter, her glare that of a beast.
She is a clan member by choice, not by blood. When her tribe is in danger, she fights with the fury of an animal.

ui_effects.localised_text: Requires line of sight to the target

skillTree.localised_description: She does not rule by fear, but by loyalty – a loyalty earned in battle.

attributes.bullet_text: The unit is immune to psychological attacks (Fear & Terror).

related_attributes.bullet_text: This unit does not suffer any form of leadership loss and will never rout.

skillTree.localised_description: It is no easy task to bend or break the armour of this being.
There is nothing but utter belief. There is no reasoning with this one.
"Don't look into their eyes, there is only death there!"
Such is this one's conviction that others have no choice but to believe.
Speaking words of power or faith can alter perceptions on the battlefield.
This one will not go down easily – it will be necessary to break both the will and the body first.
An omen, a sign - this being knows things and any who follow will share their glory.
Never to be broken or dishonoured – never to succumb to the foe.
This one fights with a fervour to be both admired and despised.
Whether it be training harder, travelling lighter, eating less or sleeping better, there's always a way to draw more from the day.
